source: Production Redis incremental AOF parsed in place; only allowlisted sanitized call mailbox metadata exported.
limitations: Encrypted event envelopes were not exported or interpreted.
An event ACK does not prove media connection or user acceptance.
A pending tombstone after all events were acknowledged is normal until TTL; absence of canceled state is not proof of an active call.
Call aliases group equal opaque handles, whose semantics require source verification. Recipient and sender identities are replaced with stable per-run aliases.
registrationTimingLimit: Registration rows have no receipt timestamp. Bounds are adjacent observed call-event/terminal timestamps in AOF command order, not exact registration times. Delete may be explicit revocation or expiry; source/circumstances must distinguish.
